objective: To keep the Crossdock Master of GTOPAS equal to NSP by an RPA process (no interface file, decided 11-Nov): [Sync] on XD01 starts the bot; the bot downloads the Export Excel of Export Crossdock Master (ongoing period) from NSP, fills the work sheet "GTOPAS Compare" in the file and maintains GTOPAS screen Crossdock Master (WVJA5204, menu Supply > Master > Crossdock Master) (decided 17-Nov).

Per part + destination: in NSP (Active) and not in GTOPAS -> registered; in both -> skipped (no change); in GTOPAS and not in NSP -> deleted. Inactive parts are not in the NSP list, so their rows in GTOPAS are deleted. [Sync] sends every part with status Active (ongoing period) or Inactive whose Sync Status is No Sync or Failed, whatever the filter (Candidate never) (definition of XD01, 17-Nov).
Only the part + destination list is maintained; Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date and Case/Day are not sent (GTOPAS keeps no Case/Day).

The bot runs with try-catch: any error stops the run and the whole run is Failed (one fails, all fail). The result is kept per part in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT and, together with XD07 (AP POLE), gives the overall Sync Status on XD01.

steps.text: [Sync] on XD01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3', IF_STATUS = '3' for 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT) and starts the RPA bot. Write LOG1. The whole bot run is inside one try-catch (step 6).
children: Waiting parts = every part with status Active (ongoing period) or Inactive whose Sync Status is No Sync or Failed, whatever the filter (Candidate never).
Active part: its destinations of the ongoing period are registered / kept in GTOPAS. Inactive part: all its rows are deleted (none to delete when it was never synced; it still gets Success).

steps.text: The bot logs in to NSP, opens XD01 Crossdock Master Setting, tab Export Crossdock Master, Calculation period = ongoing, Sync Status = All, clicks [Search] and [Export Excel], and opens the downloaded file Crossdock_Export_Master_<Period>_YYYYMMDD.xlsx.
children: NSP list = rows of sheet Export Crossdock Master with a Destination Code (Active parts of the ongoing period, one row per part + destination). A row with an empty Destination Code = Active part without destination. Inactive parts are not in this sheet.
Waiting parts = Sync Status Waiting in the file (Active and Inactive). Inactive parts are not in sheet Export Crossdock Master, so all their rows in GTOPAS are deleted by the compare.

steps.text: The bot opens GTOPAS menu Supply > Master > Crossdock Master (WVJA5204), enters Depot Code 01 (other conditions blank), clicks [Search] and reads every page ([NextPage]).
children: GTOPAS list = one row per P/No. + Destination Code. P/No. is shown with "-" (52119-BZV60): the bot removes "-" before comparing (52119BZV60).
In NSP and in GTOPAS: skip (no change).
In NSP and not in GTOPAS: register the row on the screen: Depot Code 01, Maker Code A, P/No., Dom/Os 2, Destination Code, TOPAS Order Type 3, Trans Code 2; message MZD34006FEI = done.

The bot adds the sheet GTOPAS Compare to the file: one row per P/No. + Destination Code of NSP or GTOPAS with In NSP, In GTOPAS and Action (Keep / Add / Delete); after each action it fills Result, GTOPAS message and Done date-time.

steps.text: In GTOPAS and not in NSP: delete the row (MT = DEL); message MZD34006FEI = done.
children: This covers destinations removed in NSP, parts that became Inactive (all their rows) and Active parts without destination.

steps.text: Try-catch: any error (login, screen not available, timeout, error message instead of MZD34006FEI, NSP download failed or the Excel cannot be read) stops the bot at once.
children: The whole run is Failed (one fails, all fail): LOG4 with the step and the row of the error. The rows already registered / deleted before the error stay in GTOPAS (no rollback on the screen); the next [Sync] compares again and completes them.

steps.text: Set the result of every Waiting part for 'GTOPAS' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT and the overall Sync Status:
children: No error: IF_STATUS = '1', IF_MESSAGE = 'registered <n>, deleted <n>' of the part. Error: IF_STATUS = '2' for every Waiting part, IF_MESSAGE = error of LOG4.

TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: CHANGED_DT changed since step 2 -> '0' (No Sync); else 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE' both '1' -> '1' (Success), one '2' -> '2' (Failed), one still '3' -> stays '3'. SYNC_DT = now when 1 or 2.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source RPA, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'GTOPAS: ' + IF_MESSAGE.

steps: Write LOG2 with the counts (NSP rows, GTOPAS rows, registered, skipped, deleted) and the status. Exit.

items: The D/S team maintains the destinations of each part on XD01 (Export Crossdock Master of the ongoing period, created by XD05 process 2 and adjusted by screen or upload XD03). Every change of a value sent to GTOPAS / AP POLE sets the part to No Sync (Sync Status rule of XD01, 17-Nov).

The D/S team clicks [Sync] when the changes are complete. [Sync] sends every part with status Active (ongoing period) or Inactive whose Sync Status is No Sync or Failed, whatever the filter (Candidate never). The RPA bot makes the Crossdock Master of GTOPAS equal to NSP, and XD07 updates AP POLE by RPA (screens WLM9Q890 / WLM9Q860).

RPA only (decided 11-Nov): the D/S team only clicks [Sync]. The bot downloads the XD01 Export Excel, fills the work sheet GTOPAS Compare and works on GTOPAS screen Crossdock Master (WVJA5204); it does not read the NSP database (decided 17-Nov). Steps with the screens: deliverables/user_guide/Crossdock_User_Guide_GTOPAS.xlsx.
The bot always compares the whole list (all Active parts of NSP with all rows of GTOPAS Depot 01), not only the Waiting parts, so a run that stopped earlier is completed by the next run.

items: Compare key: P/No. (without "-") + Destination Code. GTOPAS shows P/No. with "-" (52119-BZV60), NSP without (52119BZV60). Destination Code = buyer code + PD code and must be exactly the same in NSP and GTOPAS: no conversion; equal code = match (decided 11-Nov).
Fixed values to register (decided 11-Nov): Depot Code 01, Maker Code A, Domestic/Overseas 2, TOPAS Order Type 3, Order Transportation Code 2.
Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date and Case/Day are not sent. A change of Case/Day only gives no change in GTOPAS; the part still gets Success.
Example: part 52119BZV60 in NSP with 9722D10, 9811110; in GTOPAS with 9811110, 9618274 -> register 9722D10, skip 9811110, delete 9618274.
The whole bot run is in one try-catch. Any error stops the run: login failed, screen not available, timeout, an error message instead of MZD34006FEI, NSP download failed or the Excel cannot be read.
One fails, all fail: every Waiting part gets 'GTOPAS' IF_STATUS = '2' (Failed) with the error, and the overall Sync Status Failed; the D/S team clicks [Sync] again.
Rows registered / deleted before the error stay in GTOPAS (the screen has no rollback). The next run compares again, skips them and completes the rest.
A part changed on XD01 or by upload while the bot runs gets SYNC_STATUS = No Sync, so the newer data is sent by the next [Sync].
TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT keeps the result per part and target (GTOPAS by XD06, AP POLE by XD07); the overall Sync Status needs both.
On Success of the run: IF_STATUS 1, IF_DT and LAST_SYNC_DT = date-time of the result for every Waiting part. On Failed: IF_STATUS 2 and IF_DT only; LAST_SYNC_DT is not changed.
The cloud flow of the RPA sends one email per run of XD06 (GTOPAS), so the user knows the result without opening NSP.
One email per target: XD06 (GTOPAS) and XD07 (AP POLE) run as separate bots, so a [Sync] gives two emails.
One email per run: the retries of the same run do not send an email; only the final result does.

items: Example subject: [Crossdock Sync][GTOPAS][FAILED] Run 20261127103000 - 12 part(s).
Recipients (mailing list, RPA PIC, NSP PIC) are set in the flow settings, not in the code of the bot.
LOG6 is written when the email is sent; when sending fails, the run result stays and the RPA PIC sees it in the Power Automate run history.

No response from the RPA (20-Nov): NSP does not receive the result of XD06 / XD07. [Sync] sets the parts to Sent (SYNC_STATUS '3', IF_STATUS '3', IF_DT and LAST_SYNC_DT = send time); Success / Failed are not kept in NSP. The result comes by the notification e-mail of Power Automate (SUCCESS / FAILED with the work file). When the e-mail says FAILED, D/S clicks [Re-send last Sync].

The bot writes nothing back to NSP: the steps "set the result in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT", "overall Sync Status" and "history SYNC" of the function flow and the data edit mapping of these tables are not used. NSP writes them when it sends ([Sync] on XD01 or the Period Rollover of XD05).
Try-catch: an error stops the run and the e-mail is FAILED (E2 / E3). Rows already changed on the target screen stay; [Re-send last Sync] compares again and completes them.

Parts of the run: NSP passes the send time (run ID) when it starts the flow; the bot takes the rows with Sync Status Sent and Last Sent Date = that send time from the downloaded Export Excel (parts sent earlier are not processed again).
Evidence of a run: the e-mail and the work file (sheet Compare) with action, result and message per row.
FB-176: every GTOPAS row (Depot 01) not in NSP is deleted: at go-live all crossdock parts of GTOPAS must exist in NSP, else they are deleted by the first run - TBC.
RPA design: login user, time limit and screen handling of the bot - detailed in the RPA design.

GTOPAS has no period: the bot always compares with the Current period of the Export Crossdock Master. The Next period (made on day D) reaches GTOPAS only on day 1, after the Period Rollover (XD05 process 3), which starts XD06 automatically.
Order Type: GTOPAS keeps one row per P/No. + Destination Code. A destination mapped with two order types in NSP is one GTOPAS row (Keep / Add once).
Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and Case/Day are not sent (no change for GTOPAS).
